purpose: Exploratory current-session pipeline reliability pilot, not authenticated production-provider or promotion evidence
selection_policy: Six current US executable buys plus the US sell and independently rechecked neutral COST; selected before this pilot's outcomes, but from the current surviving watchlist
benchmark: strict equal-weight buy_and_hold; rolling_long diagnostic separately
model_identity: Codex based on GPT-6; exact deployed model revision and training cutoff unavailable
limitations: SEC filing events are not complete production news
FRED DFF is not full macro coverage
Short clustered sample cannot satisfy minimum effective n of 30
Historical model-knowledge contamination cannot be excluded
Session consensus-only conviction differs from production min(model score, consensus); parity arm to be reported separately
